Cause chaos with For Honor's new Wu Lin Hero, Juren. 

Available on January 29, 2026. 

About For Honor:
Carve a path of destruction through the battlefield fighting for guts, glory, and survival in For Honor. Enter the chaos of a raging war as a Hero from some of the greatest warrior legacies ever known. For Honor is a fast-paced and immersive experience, mixing skill with visceral, never-before-seen melee combat.

Enjoy incredible seasonal content, engaging campaign and thrilling multiplayer with friends online, in split screen two-player co-op, or solo against AI.

description:
Rupture, wielding Katars & Rocket Lance, burrows into battle! Play with everyone everywhere for free: https://www.brawlhalla.com/play

About Brawlhalla:
Brawlhalla is a 2D platform fighter and Free-to-Play on PC, Mac, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and Mobile devices.

It offers intense, competitive online play and engaging offline modes to allow players to fully customize their fight experience. The game has a thriving esports scene and is regularly updated. Each Legend in Brawlhalla has an exciting backstory and uses a unique weapon combination and signature attacks to defeat their fellow contenders. 

Join the fight now!

#Ubisoft #Brawlhalla

author: Ubisoft
description:
From January 21st to February 4th, the Freeze for All returns for a chilling winter showdown! 

On the icy grounds of the Arctic Workshop, dive into an 8-Operator face-off in a fast-paced free-for-all battle where every player is an opponent. With infinite respawns and the Frozen Souls mechanic, the race to 40 kills has never been frostier...or faster!

More info: https://www.rainbow6.com/freezeforall

About Rainbow Six Siege X:
Rainbow Six Siege X is an exciting, new approach to the first-person shooter experience that puts tactical combat and masterful destruction at the center of the action. Lead your team of unique operators through tense and thrilling combat scenarios, and achieve victory through smart preparation and strategic improvisation. Rainbow Six Siege X is available now on Xbox, PlayStation® and PC.

#Ubisoft #R6SiegeX
